dct_description_sm: This layer maps individual trees classified into two main types: deciduous and coniferous. The data is derived from high-resolution orthophoto imagery acquired seasonally (spring and fall) through Nearmap. Attributes include the tree type classification and whether the tree is situated in a park. This layer supports general presentation and analysis purposes.
